text:
Alex Tuch has 11 goals in 15 games in his first season in Washington, and two of them came against Buffalo on Oct. 24. The Sabres part isn't over off the ice either. Yahoo Sports ran "Alex Tuch's Buffalo Exit Gets Messy as Sabres GM Pushes Back on His Claims" on Nov. 5.

On the ice he has been one of the league's most valuable goal scorers so far: our wins-added measure ranks him 11th of 506 skaters, because his goals have come when games were in the balance. The chances are real, 1.63 expected goals per 60, well up from last season.

But 26% shooting, against 17% last season, won't hold, and he has 11 goals on 7.8 expected. The odd part is that his teammates have been unlucky with him on the ice: they've scored 4.9 fewer goals than their chances deserve, which is why he has only 2 assists. Expect fewer goals and more helpers, and roughly the same player.
headline: Tuch's fresh start comes with a messy exit
